pages.title: A Chest That Grows
pages.text: Requires the Storage System skill unlocked in the Skill Tree first - the recipe stays visible even before then, but crafting it early produces nothing. Once unlocked, each Living Chest holds 5 slots on its own.

pages.title: Merging by Touch
pages.text: Push two Living Chests flush against each other on any side and they merge into a single shared pool automatically - no wiring, no linking item. Keep adding chests and the pool keeps growing, up to a cap of 15 chests per cluster. Breaking one just drops that chest's own contents; the rest of the cluster keeps working.

pages.title: Raising the Cap
pages.text: The 15-chest cap can be raised further with Storage Network Expansion, a repeatable Skill Tree upgrade beneath Storage System. Each level costs more Arcane Ink than the last and permanently raises how many Living Chests a network you build can hold.
